tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Read a page of Git commit history. For the first page omit cursor or pass null, for example {"limit":5,"cursor":null}. For subsequent pages pass the exact next cursor returned by this tool. Never construct a cursor from a short commit hash, HEAD or a branch name. An empty repository returns an empty history. Omit worktree for this turn's directory, or select a registered worktree ID from list_worktrees in the same project.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Read a commit patch, or a UTF-8 file at a commit without changing the checkout. revision defaults to HEAD; omit path for the bounded commit patch. For file pages offset is a zero-based line offset and limit defaults to 200, at most 500. Text includes one-based line numbers. Use the returned immutable commit and next offset for continuation. Pages are bounded to 48 KiB and files to 32 MiB; truncation and an incomplete line are explicit. Binary files return a binary marker. Select only registered worktrees in this session project.

revision.description: Git commit revision; defaults to HEAD

tools.name: git_blame
tools.description: Read committed line authorship without changing the checkout. path is literal and worktree-relative; revision defaults to HEAD, excluding uncommitted changes. offset is zero-based and limit defaults to 200, at most 500. Use the returned immutable commit and next offset for continuation. Pages contain at most 48 KiB of line text; individual truncated lines are marked. Files must be committed regular UTF-8 text files at most 32 MiB. Select only registered worktrees in this session project.

revision.description: Git commit revision; defaults to HEAD

tools.name: list_git_changes
tools.description: List changed file metadata without reading source bodies. Omit target and cursor for all working changes; select an explicit worktree, commit or range target otherwise. Exactly one target or cursor is accepted. Continue using next verbatim; use cursor {snapshot,after_path:null} to repeat from the same frozen target. Commits and ranges resolve once to full SHAs. Each page has at most 500 entries and 48 KiB encoded JSON. Only exhausted=true and omitted_paths=0 proves complete inventory. No patches, statistics or rename similarity are computed. Select only registered worktrees in this session project.

tools.name: read_git_change
tools.description: Read a literal file diff from a returned Git changes snapshot. Every request requires the unchanged snapshot, the selected file's path and its metadata_revision as expected_metadata_revision. Do not use snapshot.metadata_revision for the file revision. The first request uses offset=0; omit expected_revision unless a strong file revision is already captured. Every continuation or later check supplies the returned strong revision. offset counts mapped diff lines, limit defaults to 200 and is at most 500. Complete source lines preserve whitespace except terminal CR/LF and carry one-based old/new line numbers. Pages are bounded to 48 KiB encoded JSON without truncating lines. Binary, non-UTF-8, unsupported modes, oversized files and oversized lines return an explicit skip_reason. Commit snapshots remain fixed when references move; working snapshots reject metadata or content changes. Files are bounded to 32 MiB. Select only registered worktrees in this session project.

snapshot.description: Complete snapshot returned by the change inventory or review scope; pass it unchanged on every page

path.description: Path of the selected file entry in this snapshot; required on every page

expected_metadata_revision.description: The selected file entry's metadata_revision, not snapshot.metadata_revision

expected_revision.description: Strong revision of this file from the review scope or a previous read; required for continuation
